description: MEASURED old-vs-new dative-candidate rule delta on real Pt tmQM clouds (metal-first atom ordering). Counts every i<j pair; 'old head' is the pre-Wf-A92 asymmetric donor(i)&metal(j) test over triu indices, 'new head' adds the transpose. 'old featurise' is the pre-Wf-A92 hardcoded Pt-only N/O/S rule.
scope: Wf-A92 symmetric-dative fix, measured on a corpus that actually orders the metal first (the fix was bit-exact on MetalCytoTox, where the metal is appended last)
interpretation: The old rule encoded 87.8% of all dative flags as 0 on tmQM, and 88.3% of clouds had at least one dropped flag. 828 of the 1,763 dropped pairs are within 2.5 A, i.e. at coordination-bond scale rather than long-range noise. MetalCytoTox was blind to this only because it appends the metal last (donor index < metal index).
